_comment: perspective() x translateZ() — the regression pin for the 2026-08-28 both-natives fix (docs/STATUS.md 'perspective + translateZ was wrong on both natives', commit 278d23a1). css-transforms-2 §3: under perspective(P), a point at depth z projects with scale P/(P-z), so 'perspective(P) translateZ(z)' on a flat element is a PURE UNIFORM SCALE of P/(P-z) about the transform origin — arithmetic-clean, so it reads straight off the bbox. This combination had ZERO fixture coverage when iOS shipped no depth response at all (60x20 at every z) and Compose shipped the first-order Taylor expansion 1+z/P (0.5x rendered as 0.1x via a clamp at z=-P); a hole this fixture permanently closes. Base box 60x20 #2ecc71=(46,204,113) for the growth rows; the shrink row uses a 120x40 base so its result (1200 px of pure fill) still dominates the harness name label. ARITHMETIC — PTZ_Z0_Control: scale 500/(500-0) = 1.0 -> [60,20] (also pins that perspective alone is the identity on a flat, unrotated element). PTZ_Z100: 500/400 = 1.25 -> 60*1.25 x 20*1.25 = [75,25]. PTZ_Z166: 500/334 = 1.4970 -> 89.82 x 29.94 -> [90,30] (the row where the Taylor expansion 1+166/500 = 1.332 visibly diverges: it would read [80,27]). PTZ_Z250: 500/250 = 2.0 -> [120,40] (Taylor reads 1.5 -> [90,30]). PTZ_ZNeg500: 500/1000 = 0.5 on the 120x40 base -> [60,20] (the clearest tell: the expansion evaluates to 1+(-500/500) = 0 and was only rescued by a 0.1 clamp -> [12,4]; a no-depth-response runtime reads [120,40]). All five rows were byte-identical across the three platforms after the fix — this fixture must stay green, and any future red here is a regression, not a new finding. GEOMETRY NOTE: the uniform margin keeps transform-escaped paint inside the overflow:hidden 390x(layout+32) capture canvas (CaptureGallery.tsx canvasStyle) — without it a CORRECT renderer clips at the canvas edge and the box expectation reads false-red on every platform. Do not 'simplify' the margin away.

scale 500/400 = 1.25 -> 75x25 (STATUS measured 74x24 pure-fill after edge AA — inside tolerance)
